description: Semantic steering knowledge: what the LLM must be guided toward (REQUIRED) and steered away from (FORBIDDEN) for each family and type. Derived from empirical pilot observations.

global_forbidden: FORBIDDEN: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources — sub-namespace does not exist
FORBIDDEN: TextAbsorber — use TextExtractor (LowCode API), not TextAbsorber (core API)
FORBIDDEN: PdfFileEditor — use Merger/Splitter (LowCode API), not PdfFileEditor (Facades API)
FORBIDDEN: new PluginOptions() — PluginOptions is abstract; use the concrete options class

required: REQUIRED: new MergeOptions() — use MergeOptions as the concrete options class
REQUIRED: options.AddInput(new FileDataSource( — add all input files via AddInput
REQUIRED: options.AddOutput(new FileDataSource( — set output file via AddOutput
REQUIRED: new Merger().Process(options) — call Process on instance
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.Text; (for TextFragment fixture creation)
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources — sub-namespace does not exist
Merger.rationale: Merger uses MergeOptions (not PluginOptions). AddOutput takes FileDataSource (IDataSource), NOT FileSaveTarget (ISaveTarget). TextFragment fixture requires Aspose.Pdf.Text namespace.

required: REQUIRED: new SplitOptions() — use SplitOptions as the concrete options class
REQUIRED: options.AddInput(new FileDataSource( — add input file via AddInput
REQUIRED: options.AddOutput(new FileDataSource( — set output file via AddOutput
REQUIRED: new Splitter().Process(options) — call Process on instance
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.Text; (for TextFragment fixture creation)
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources — sub-namespace does not exist
Splitter.rationale: Splitter non-deterministically uses TextFragment in fixture; Text namespace must be REQUIRED. Output filename must be plain string, not format string with {0}.

required: REQUIRED: new OptimizeOptions() — use OptimizeOptions as the concrete options class
REQUIRED: options.AddInput(new FileDataSource( — add input file via AddInput
REQUIRED: options.AddOutput(new FileDataSource( — set output file via AddOutput
REQUIRED: new Optimizer().Process(options) — call Process on instance
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources — sub-namespace does not exist
Optimizer.rationale: Optimizer follows the standard AddInput/AddOutput/Process pattern.

required: REQUIRED: new TextExtractorOptions() — use TextExtractorOptions as the concrete options class
REQUIRED: options.AddInput(new FileDataSource( — add input file via AddInput
REQUIRED: new TextExtractor().Process(options) — call Process on instance
REQUIRED: StringResult — read text from result via cast to StringResult
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.Text; (for TextFragment fixture creation)
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: TextAbsorber — use TextExtractor (LowCode API), not TextAbsorber (core API)
FORBIDDEN: options.AddOutput( — TextExtractor has NO AddOutput; read StringResult from result.ResultCollection
TextExtractor.rationale: TextExtractor has no AddOutput; text is returned via result.ResultCollection[0] cast to StringResult. AddOutput would cause a build error.

required: REQUIRED: new PdfAConvertOptions( — use PdfAConvertOptions as the concrete options class (NOT PluginOptions)
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf; (for PdfAStandard enum)
REQUIRED: options.AddInput(new FileDataSource( — add input file via AddInput
REQUIRED: options.AddOutput(new FileDataSource( — set output file via AddOutput
REQUIRED: new PdfAConverter().Process(options) — call Process on instance
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.Text; (for TextFragment fixture creation)
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: new PluginOptions() — PluginOptions is abstract, use PdfAConvertOptions
FORBIDDEN: LowCodeLoadOptions — wrong options class for PdfAConverter
FORBIDDEN: LowCodeSaveOptions — wrong options class for PdfAConverter
PdfAConverter.rationale: PdfAConvertOptions is the concrete class. LLM defaults to PluginOptions (abstract), LowCodeLoadOptions, or LowCodeSaveOptions — all wrong. Must be explicit.

global_forbidden: FORBIDDEN: Document.Save() replacing Converter.Convert() — use LowCode API
FORBIDDEN: manual find/replace loops replacing Replacer.Replace() — use LowCode API
FORBIDDEN: manual watermark shapes replacing Watermarker.SetText() — use LowCode API

required: REQUIRED: Converter.Convert(inputFile, outputFile — static entry, two-argument form
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Words; (for Document fixture creation)
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: Document.Save() as primary conversion — must use LowCode Converter.Convert()
Converter.rationale: Converter.Convert is the primary LowCode API. Document.Save() is a core API substitution.

required: REQUIRED: Watermarker.SetText(inputFile, outputFile, — static entry
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Words; (for Document fixture creation)
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: manual shape/header insertion replacing Watermarker.SetText()
Watermarker.rationale: Watermarker.SetText is the primary LowCode API. Text watermarks are stored as VML shapes in word/header*.xml.

required: REQUIRED: Splitter.ExtractPages(inputFile, outputFile — static entry
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Words; (for Document fixture creation)
Splitter.rationale: Splitter.ExtractPages is the primary LowCode API.

required: REQUIRED: Replacer.Replace(inputFile, outputFile — static entry
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Words; (for Document fixture creation)
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: manual regex loops replacing Replacer.Replace()
Replacer.rationale: Replacer.Replace is the primary LowCode API.

required: REQUIRED: MailMerger.Execute( — static entry, execute mail merge
REQUIRED: InsertField("MERGEFIELD — create MERGEFIELD fields in template via DocumentBuilder.InsertField
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Words; (for Document+DocumentBuilder fixture creation)
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: manual string replacement instead of MailMerger.Execute()
MailMerger.rationale: MailMerger.Execute requires a template DOCX with MERGEFIELD fields created via DocumentBuilder.InsertField. Constraint token must be simple ('InsertField') not complex.

Processor.rationale: Processor has constructors:[] and all instance methods — cannot be instantiated or called statically. Removed from allowed_types. Requires ProcessorContext factory investigation or Aspose.Words version upgrade.

global_forbidden: FORBIDDEN: Workbook.Save() as primary conversion — use LowCode API
cells.note: All 9 published examples pass without per-type constraints. Add before any rerun to protect against repair regression.

global_forbidden: FORBIDDEN: IDiagramPlugin core interface replacing LowCode DiagramConverter.Process()
FORBIDDEN: manual VSDX file manipulation replacing LowCode API

required: REQUIRED: DiagramConverter.Process( — primary LowCode call
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Diagram; (for Diagram fixture creation)
DiagramConverter.rationale: DiagramConverter.Process() is the primary LowCode API.

required: REQUIRED: PdfConverter.Process( — primary LowCode call
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Diagram; (for Diagram fixture creation)
PdfConverter.rationale: PdfConverter.Process() is the primary LowCode API.

global_forbidden: FORBIDDEN: MailMessage.Save() as primary conversion — use LowCode Converter.Convert()

required: REQUIRED: Converter.Convert( — primary LowCode call (static)
Converter.rationale: Not yet piloted. Constraints anticipated from pattern analysis.

email.note: Email is in DISCOVERY_ONLY state. Constraints are anticipatory — validate empirically when pilot launches.

global_forbidden: FORBIDDEN: Presentation.Save() replacing Convert.ToPdf() or similar LowCode method
FORBIDDEN: manual slide manipulation replacing Compress.* methods

required: REQUIRED: Convert.ToPdf( or Convert.ToJpeg( or Convert.AutoByExtension( — primary LowCode call (static)
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Slides; (for Presentation fixture creation)
Convert.rationale: Not yet piloted. Constraints are anticipatory.

required: REQUIRED: Compress.RemoveUnusedLayoutSlides( or Compress.CompressEmbeddedFonts( — primary LowCode call (static)
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: manual slide/layout removal replacing Compress.*
Compress.rationale: Not yet piloted. Constraints are anticipatory.

required: REQUIRED: Merger.Process( — primary LowCode call
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Slides; (for Presentation fixture creation)
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: manual slide copy replacing Merger.Process()
Merger.rationale: Not yet piloted. Pair fixture strategy needed (2 PPTX inputs).

slides.note: Slides is in DISCOVERY_ONLY state. Missing XML docs may affect generation quality (DLL name mismatch, fallback implemented).
